candidates.sentence: Depending on the reason for immigration, the type of application will vary.
Unfortunately, not all immigration applicants will be accepted to come into the United States.
A refugee or asylum seeker application will vary differently from a normal immigration application.
Each immigration case will be different and approval times may vary, but eventually, citizenship status can be a reality.
In order to immigrate to the United States, the right immigration application must be filled out, turned in to the proper authority, and approved.
